summary.text: Dave McCormick is a U.S. Senator from Pennsylvania and serves on the Foreign Relations, Energy and Natural Resources, and Banking committees.

paragraphs.text: He was born in Washington, Pennsylvania, raised in Bloomsburg, graduated from West Point, and served in the 82nd Airborne Division, including in the first Gulf War, retiring as a Captain.

He earned a Ph.D. in international relations from Princeton, was CEO of FreeMarkets, served as Under Secretary of the Treasury and Deputy National Security Advisor, and was CEO of Bridgewater Associates before running for Senate in 2022.
